outcome: the task's own tests/test.sh after the agent exited: reward.txt 1 = resolved

steps.command: ls -la && echo "--- INPUT HEAD ---" && head -5 input.csv && echo "--- EXPECTED HEAD ---" && head -5 expected.csv && echo "--- LINE COUNTS ---" && wc -l input.csv expected.csv

cd /app
echo "--- sample 20 ---"; paste -d'|' <(head -20 input.csv) <(head -20 expected.csv)
echo "--- expected suffix counts ---"; awk -F';' '{print $NF}' expected.csv | sort | uniq -c | head
echo "--- field count input ---"; awk -F',' '{print NF}' input.csv | sort | uniq -c
echo "--- expected field count ---"; awk -F';' '{print NF}' expected.csv | sort | uniq -c

cd /app
echo "--- char classes in input (non-alnum, non-space, non-comma) ---"
LC_ALL=C tr -d 'A-Za-z0-9 ,\n' < input.csv | fold -w1 | sort | uniq -c
echo "--- char classes expected ---"
LC_ALL=C tr -d 'A-Za-z0-9 ;\n' < expected.csv | fold -w1 | sort | uniq -c
echo "--- last bytes input ---"; tail -c 50 input.csv | xxd | tail -3
echo "--- last bytes expected ---"; tail -c 50 expected.csv | xxd | tail -3
echo "--- verify transform on all rows via python simulation ---"

cd /app
python3 - <<'EOF'
mismatch=0
with open('input.csv') as fi, open('expected.csv') as fe:
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(fi,fe)):
        a=a.rstrip('\n'); b=b.rstrip('\n')
        f=[x.strip().upper() for x in a.split(',')]
        out=';'.join(reversed(f))+';OK'
        if out!=b:
            mismatch+=1
            if mismatch<5: print(i,repr(a),repr(b),repr(out))
print("mismatches:",mismatch)
EOF

cd /app
head -1000 input.csv > /tmp/small.csv
cat > /tmp/test1.vim <<'VIMEOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/ *\\(\\S\\+\\) *, *\\(\\S\\+\\) *, *\\(\\S\\+\\) *$/\\3;\\2;\\1/\<CR>")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/$/;OK/\<CR>")
VIMEOF
echo "--- register contents ---"
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es -c 'source /tmp/test1.vim' -c 'call writefile([string(getreg("a")), string(getreg("b")), string(getreg("c"))], "/tmp/regs.txt")' -c 'qa!' </dev/null
cat /tmp/regs.txt

cd /app
head -1000 input.csv > /tmp/t.csv
cp /tmp/t.csv /tmp/t.orig
cat > /tmp/run.vim <<'VIMEOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/ *\\(\\S\\+\\) *, *\\(\\S\\+\\) *, *\\(\\S\\+\\) *$/\\3;\\2;\\1/\<CR>")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/$/;OK/\<CR>")
%normal! @a
%normal! @b
%normal! @c
wq
VIMEOF
/usr/bin/time -f "TIME %e" vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/t.csv -S /tmp/run.vim </dev/null; echo "exit=$?"
echo "--- diff vs expected head ---"
diff <(head -1000 expected.csv) /tmp/t.csv && echo "MATCH 1000"

cd /app
head -1000 input.csv > /tmp/t.csv
cat > /tmp/run.vim <<'VIMEOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/ *\\(\\S\\+\\) *, *\\(\\S\\+\\) *, *\\(\\S\\+\\) *$/\\3;\\2;\\1/\<CR>")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/$/;OK/\<CR>")
%normal! @a
%normal! @b
%normal! @c
wq
VIMEOF
start=$(date +%s.%N)
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/t.csv -S /tmp/run.vim </dev/null; ec=$?
end=$(date +%s.%N)
echo "exit=$ec time=$(echo "$end-$start"|bc)"
diff <(head -1000 expected.csv) /tmp/t.csv >/dev/null && echo "MATCH 1000" || { echo FAIL; diff <(head -3 expected.csv) <(head -3 /tmp/t.csv); }

cd /app
head -100000 input.csv > /tmp/t100k.csv
cp /tmp/t100k.csv /tmp/t100k.bak
time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/t100k.csv -S /tmp/run.vim </dev/null
echo "exit=$?"
diff <(head -100000 expected.csv) /tmp/t100k.csv >/dev/null && echo "MATCH 100k" || echo FAIL

cd /app
for m in a b c; do
  cp /tmp/t100k.bak /tmp/one.csv
  cat > /tmp/one.vim <<EOF
call setreg('a', ":s/ *\\\\(\\\\S\\\\+\\\\) *, *\\\\(\\\\S\\\\+\\\\) *, *\\\\(\\\\S\\\\+\\\\) *\$/\\\\3;\\\\2;\\\\1/\<CR>")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', "A;OK\<Esc>")
%normal! @$m
wq
EOF
  echo "== macro $m =="
  time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/one.csv -S /tmp/one.vim </dev/null
done

input.content:
call setreg('a', ":s/ *\\(\\S\\+\\) *, *\\(\\S\\+\\) *, *\\(\\S\\+\\) *$/\\3;\\2;\\1/\<CR>")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', "A;OK\<Esc>")
%normal! @a
%normal! @b

steps.command:
cd /app
head -100000 input.csv > /tmp/final100k.csv
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/final100k.csv -S /app/apply_macros.vim </dev/null; echo "exit=$?"
diff <(head -100000 expected.csv) /tmp/final100k.csv >/dev/null && echo "MATCH 100k byte-for-byte: $(cmp -s <(head -100000 expected.csv) /tmp/final100k.csv && echo yes)" || echo FAIL

cd /app
cp input.csv /tmp/input.orig.csv
time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /app/input.csv -S /app/apply_macros.vim </dev/null; echo "exit=$?"
cmp -s input.csv expected.csv && echo "BYTE-FOR-BYTE MATCH" || { echo "MISMATCH"; cmp input.csv expected.csv | head; }
ls -l input.csv expected.csv

cd /app
echo "--- apply_macros.vim ---"; cat -A apply_macros.vim
echo "--- keystroke count ---"
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es -c 'source /app/apply_macros.vim' -c 'call writefile([string(strlen(getreg("a"))+strlen(getreg("b"))+strlen(getreg("c")))], "/tmp/kc.txt")' -c 'qa!' </dev/null 2>/dev/null || true
cat /tmp/kc.txt 2>/dev/null
echo "--- md5 equality ---"; md5sum input.csv expected.csv
